report.title: Sacrificial anodes needed for six offshore structures on each edition of DNV-RP-B401 and DNV-RP-F103

code.python: 3.11; Python 3.13 and later cannot build some pinned packages (numpy<2, lxml 4.9.3, h5py 3.10.0)
code.install: Needs git and uv. git clone --filter=blob:none https://github.com/vamseeachanta/digitalmodel && cd digitalmodel && git checkout 09089a121a16069c4b657d1a320a630a23ab1dd5 && uv venv --python 3.11 && uv pip install --no-sources -e .; then run every Python step with the environment's interpreter (.venv/bin/python, or .venv\Scripts\python on Windows)

inputs.description: The six structure input files: pipeline, multi_component_riser, published_jacket_84m, reference_jacket_60m_members, monopile, manifold
Design values of each DNV edition (coating breakdown factors, current densities, anode capacities), as coded in the library
Published Figure 4 data: one row per standing structure in the counted copy
BSEE Platform Structures raw data, US Gulf of Mexico federal waters
inputs.source: US Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement, BSEE Data Center
inputs.version_or_date: counted copy retrieved 2026-10-29 10:17Z; eval uses the file of the run date

missing_data.what: The BSEE Platform Structures file counted on 29 October 2026 (SHA-256 bde13c85...)
missing_data.why: BSEE replaces the file daily and does not keep old copies; we did not archive it.
missing_data.how_to_supply: Not needed: the published Figure 4 CSV holds the standing structures of that copy.
missing_data.effect: Today's counts differ from Figure 4 by a few structures (6 November 2026: 1,294 standing against 1,301).

missing_data.what: The DNV-RP-B401 and DNV-RP-F103 documents of each edition
missing_data.how_to_supply: A reader with copies can check the library's edition values clause by clause.
missing_data.effect: The eval checks the library's results, not the library's tables against DNV text.

missing_data.what: For the reader's own structure: geometry, coating, design life, fluid temperature, anode type and alloy
missing_data.why: Only needed to adapt the study; the published result uses the library's case files.
missing_data.how_to_supply: Copy pipeline.yml, change the inputs, run the same edition loop.

cannot_do: Check the edition values against the DNV documents (paid).
Rebuild the exact Figure 4 counts from today's BSEE file: the file changes daily.
Judge an installed CP system: status.result in the library output judges the installed count of the input file, not the recommended count.
Give a design for a real structure: each structure is one modelled case.
